description: Geological and petrophysical appraisal of residual oil zones in onshore Australian basins is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Geoscience Australia and CSIRO have collaborated, under the Exploring for the Future program, to investigate whether water-saturated residual oil zones (ROZs), sometimes associated with conventional Australian hydrocarbon plays, could provide a CO2 storage resource and enhance the storage capacity of depleted fields. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are Amadeus Basin, CO2 storage in residual oil zones, Carbon Capture and Storage, Cooper Basin, EFTF. It offers 3 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2025-10-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
